g.text: One row is one block; whole plots may swap within blocks, and clipping may swap only within each main plot
Technical libraries collapse to 24 biological units
Labels show 1–3 PCR/tag libraries aggregated before inference. The resulting split-plot space contains 8^6 = 262,144 assignments.
